_disclaimer: PROVISIONAL CONFIGURATION -- NOT CLINICALLY VALIDATED. Every numeric value below is a synthetic assumption chosen only to make this infrastructure runnable and testable, for a limited synthetic research prototype. None has been reviewed by a radiation safety officer or medical physicist, none is derived from real staffing, scheduling, or sensor-reliability data, and none may be presented as clinically or regulatorily validated. See PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md section 9d and SCIENTIFIC_PARAMETER_REVIEW_PACKAGE.md for where these would need formal registry rows before any expert review.

roster_generation.source: Synthetic assumption for this research prototype, chosen only so eligible replacements exist sometimes (not always, not never) during testing; not derived from real staffing data.
roster_generation.registry_row: PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md section 9d item 2 (new sub-parameter of registry row 8, not yet a numbered methodology row)

escalation.description: Sensor-fault-driven escalation threshold (PHASE3B section 3h), deliberately independent of any dose-trigger value -- this module never reads CONFIG.doseElevated/doseCritical.
escalation.source: Synthetic assumption for this research prototype; not derived from real alerting/paging policy. This threshold governs only the simulated, in-framework escalation log in this module -- it is never connected to a real notification system.
escalation.registry_row: new -- not yet a numbered registry row; introduced by Phase 3C-A

cgdtr_trigger.description: CGDTR trigger clause (a) parameters (PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md Revision 3, section 3a): WorkerAccumulatedShiftDose >= rotation_threshold_fraction x reference_level_mSv_per_shift. `reference_level_mSv_per_shift` is this project's own per-shift stand-in for the engine's CONFIG.refAnnual (20 mSv/yr) dashboard reference level -- NOT a regulatory limit of any kind, and not the engine's own quantity (which is annual, not per-shift). Illustrative derivation shown for transparency only: 20 mSv/yr / ~250 working shifts/yr ~= 0.08 mSv/shift, rounded to an illustrative 0.1 mSv -- this derivation is itself a research assumption, not an approved dose-budgeting method.
cgdtr_trigger.source: Synthetic assumption for this research prototype; not derived from real staffing policy, clinical guidance, or regulatory dose-budgeting practice. PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md section 9d item 1 explicitly leaves rotation_threshold_fraction open -- this value exists only so the trigger is computable for testing and the campaign, not as a chosen final value.
cgdtr_trigger.registry_row: new -- not yet a numbered registry row; PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md section 9d item 1

fixed_interval_baseline.description: The fixed-interval rotation baseline's own trigger period N (ROTATION_RECOMMENDER_DESIGN_SPEC.md section 4.2; PHASE3B_ROTATION_ALGORITHM_DESIGN.md section 6 item 2). Also used, unchanged, by Ablation D (section 6a).
fixed_interval_baseline.source: Synthetic assumption for this research prototype; not derived from any real facility rotation schedule. Explicitly flagged in PHASE3B section 9c as needing a sensitivity sweep rather than being left as a single unexamined constant.
